newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila c. bank cuts overnight lending to 25 pct.
newsitem.headline: Manila c. bank cuts overnight lending to 25 pct.

text.p: The Philippine central bank said on Wednesday it lowered its overnight lending rate to 25 percent from 26 percent.
Its overnight borrowing rate was unchanged at 20 percent.
On Monday, the central bank raised its lending rate by four percentage points to 26 percent to further control liquidity.
The central bank last week increased liquidity reserves by two percentage points to four percent against deposits and trust funds to mop up pesos that may have gone to peso speculation.
"The monetary authority viewed that liquidity has not tightened that much," a trader said, leading the central bank to raise its rate.
Traders said the slight easing on Wednesday was done after many banks have already almost squared reserve positions for the week.
